paragraphs.source_en:
In
desperate hope I go and search for her in all the corners of my room; I find her not.

units.source_en:
In
desperate hope I go and search for her in all the corners of my room; I find her not.

paragraphs.source_en: My house is small and what once has gone from it can never be regained.

units.source_en: My house is small and what once has gone from it can never be regained.

paragraphs.source_en: But infinite is thy mansion, my lord, and seeking her I have come to thy door.

units.source_en: But infinite is thy mansion, my lord, and seeking her I have come to thy door.

paragraphs.source_en: I stand under the golden canopy of thine evening sky and I lift my eager eyes to thy face.

units.source_en: I stand under the golden canopy of thine evening sky and I lift my eager eyes to thy face.

paragraphs.source_en: I have come to the brink of eternity from which nothing can vanish—no hope, no happiness, no vision of a face seen through tears.

units.source_en: I have come to the brink of eternity from which nothing can vanish—no hope, no happiness, no vision of a face seen through tears.

paragraphs.source_en: Oh, dip my emptied life into that ocean, plunge it into the deepest fullness. Let me for once feel that lost sweet touch in the allness of the universe.

Let me for once feel that lost sweet touch in the allness of the universe.
